dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Everything Uptizm is watching, at a glance.
dashboard.ai_fleet_summary: Checkout is in a major outage (origin-side 503s across all regions) and API gateway is degraded as your cpu_load metric climbs. Docs is paused for maintenance. Marketing site is the only fully operational service right now.
dashboard.ai_inbox_subtitle: Anomalies Uptizm flagged from its own checks and metrics, not yet incidents. Your call.
dashboard.ai_inbox_empty: Inbox zero. No anomalies need your attention.

monitors.title: Monitors
monitors.description: Endpoints Uptizm is watching across regions.
monitors.form_slo_hint: Sets the error budget Uptizm tracks on the monitor's detail page.
monitors.form_notifications_hint: Who gets alerted about this monitor.
monitors.form_alert_down: Alert when this monitor goes down
monitors.form_escalation_hint: How an unacknowledged alert for this monitor climbs to wider responders.
monitors.form_advanced_hint: HTTP method, request headers, body, and timeout.
monitors.form_timeout_hint: Seconds before a check counts as failed.
monitors.create_header_description: Let AI configure it from a URL, or set it up by hand.
monitors.create_ai_card_description: Paste a URL and Uptizm probes it, detects the right monitor type, measures baseline latency, then picks optimal regions and health checks. You review everything before it goes live.
monitors.create_ai_review_summary: Reviewed :name, detected an HTTP JSON API responding in ~120ms. Set 30s checks from 3 regions and a 2xx + JSON health assertion. Review and adjust anything before creating.
monitors.create_ai_suggested_metrics_help: You can fine-tune these on the monitor after it's created.
monitors.empty_no_monitors_description: Add your first endpoint and Uptizm starts checking it from every region within seconds.
monitors.empty_no_match_description: Nothing in this status right now. Try a different filter or add a new monitor.
monitors.error_load_description: We hit a snag reaching your monitoring data. Try again in a moment.
monitors.reliability_burn_breached_recovering: :name's last 7 days are back inside the :slo% SLO, but the 30-day budget is already spent: the earlier outage still counts against this window.
monitors.reliability_burn_breached_burning: :name has spent its 30-day error budget and is still burning. At this rate the SLO stays breached unless the downtime stops, worth tightening its escalation policy.
monitors.reliability_burn_at_risk: :name has burned most of its 30-day budget. A few more minutes of downtime this window would breach the :slo% SLO.
monitors.response_insight_anomaly: Flagged a p99 spike at 13:00, well above :name's expected band and isolated to ap-southeast with no errors. Reads as regional latency on that path, not an origin outage.
monitors.response_insight_clear: :name is holding within its expected response band this window. No anomalies flagged.
monitors.paused_description: Uptizm isn't probing this monitor right now. Resume it to collect response times again.
monitors.no_response_data_description: This monitor isn't returning a response time right now, so there's nothing to chart for this window.
monitors.no_incidents_description: This monitor has no incidents on record. Uptizm opens one automatically the moment something goes wrong.
monitors.action_edit_coming_soon: Editing a monitor is coming soon.
monitors.confirm_pause_description: Uptizm stops checking this monitor and won't open incidents or alert until you resume it.
monitors.confirm_delete_description: This removes the monitor along with its check history and metrics. Past incidents stay on record. This can't be undone.
monitors.metrics_empty_description: Point at your own endpoint or page — server RAM/CPU from a JSON route, a load time from the DOM — and Uptizm parses and records the value on every check.
monitors.metrics_detail_band_insight: Shaded band is Uptizm's learned expected range. :label stepped outside it once in the last 24h (at :time), :phrase its normal range.
monitors.metrics_form_key_hint: Lowercase, snake_case. Used in charts and alert rules.
monitors.metrics_form_key_error: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.
monitors.metrics_form_test_hint: Fetch a live sample to verify this rule resolves a value.
monitors.metrics_form_ai_suggestion: This metric typically reads near :value. Based on that baseline, Uptizm suggests warn at :warn and critical at :crit.
monitors.metrics_confirm_delete_description: This removes the custom metric and its recorded history. This can't be undone.

status.list_description: Public pages that show your service health to customers.
status.list_empty_description: Publish a branded page so customers can see your uptime, follow incidents, and subscribe to updates.
status.list_error_load_description: We hit a snag loading your pages. Try again in a moment.
status.editor_section_components_hint: Assigned monitors appear as public components, carrying their incidents.
status.editor_section_metrics_hint: Publish live metrics from your assigned monitors to visitors.
status.editor_section_subscriptions_hint: Let visitors subscribe by email to get incident and maintenance updates.
status.editor_form_slug_hint: The URL path or subdomain where this page is published.
status.editor_form_logo_hint: Upload a square image (PNG/SVG). Falls back to initials when empty.
status.editor_form_logo_text_hint: Used in the brand mark when no logo image is set.
status.editor_form_subscribers_hint: People getting updates for this page.
status.editor_ai_draft_banner_text: Uptizm can set this up for you: it groups your monitors into public components and writes a starter description from what it already watches. You review and edit before publishing.
status.editor_ai_applied_banner: Drafted from your monitors. Edit anything below, then create the page.
status.editor_ai_draft_gated: AI drafting is available on the :plan plan.
status.editor_form_no_monitors_hint: Assign monitors above, then their metrics show up here to publish.
status.editor_form_no_system_metrics: No assigned monitor reports a response time yet.
status.editor_form_no_custom_metrics: No custom metrics on the assigned monitors.
status.preview_components_empty: No components yet. Assign monitors to show their status here.
status.preview_subscribe_description: Get notified by email when an incident is opened, updated, or resolved.
status.subscribers_empty_subs_enabled_descripti: When visitors subscribe on your public status page, they'll show up here.
status.subscribers_empty_subs_disabled_descript: Subscriptions are turned off for this page. Enable them in the editor to let visitors subscribe.
status.subscribers_remove_confirm_description: :email will stop receiving status updates for :page.

ai.anomaly_dismissed_description: Marked as ":reason". Uptizm weighs this in future detection.
ai.analysis_disclaimer: Uptizm AI reasons only from your monitoring checks and metrics; it can't see inside your app. Verify before acting.

incidents.list_description: Active and past incidents across your monitors.
incidents.empty_never_had_description: When a check fails or a metric breaches its band, Uptizm opens an incident here, automatically.
incidents.empty_filtered_description: No incidents match this view. Uptizm will open one automatically the moment something goes wrong.
incidents.error_load_description: We hit a snag reaching your incident history. Try again in a moment.
incidents.form_description: File an incident manually. Uptizm opens incidents automatically too, but you can post one yourself.
incidents.form_affected_hint: These drive the status page components and subscriber notifications.
incidents.form_severity_hint: Operator-side priority. Customer-facing impact is set below.
incidents.form_impact_hint: How this reads to your customers on the public page.
incidents.form_first_update_hint: The opening post your subscribers will see.
incidents.form_first_update_placeholder_incident: We're investigating elevated error rates on checkout.
incidents.form_first_update_placeholder_maintenanc: We'll be performing scheduled maintenance. A brief read-only period is expected.
incidents.form_notify_hint: Email everyone subscribed to the affected components.
incidents.ai_promoted_explainer: We pre-filled the monitor, a draft title, and a severity from the anomaly. Nothing was opened automatically: review the details below and open the incident when you're ready.
incidents.ai_generic_banner: Uptizm AI analyzes this incident the moment you open it: root cause, evidence, and suggested actions land on the detail page within seconds. You stay in control, nothing acts without your approval.
incidents.detail_timeline_empty: No public updates yet. Post one below to keep subscribers informed.
incidents.detail_composer_placeholder: What's the latest? This is what subscribers will see on the status page.
incidents.detail_composer_ai_insight: Uptizm AI drafted this from the incident signals. Edit it before posting.
incidents.ai_analysis_gated: AI incident analysis pinpoints the likely cause with evidence, confidence, and next steps.
